excerpt: When users directly access URLs like `https://yourdomain.com/orders`, CloudFront/S3 returns 404 because these routes don't exist as physical files.
Configure CloudFront to redirect all non-asset requests to `index.html` so Angular can handle the routing.
Add these Custom Error Response configurations in CloudFront:
Use a CloudFront Function to handle SPA routing more elegantly:
AFFECTED=$(npx nx show projects --affected --base=$BASE_BRANCH --head=HEAD --plain | tr '\n' ' ' | xargs)
